responsibility: Enumerates the builtin function families for the T-Head XTheadVector extension in the RVV intrinsic framework. Its `DEF_RVV_FUNCTION` entries declare T-Head-specific load/store-width, indexed/strided access, and extract builtin groups together with their shapes, predication support, operand type families, and required extension, providing the declarative intrinsic inventory consumed by the vector builtin generator.
